### Jacob and Rachel
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jacob-and-rachel
Passage: Genesis 29:1-12
Points:
- Jacob resumed his journey with renewed purpose and confidence, bolstered by the covenant promises God gave him at Bethel.
- Although God is not explicitly mentioned in the scene, His hidden providence clearly orchestrates Jacob's arrival at the well.
- Rachel's diligent work as a shepherdess mirrors Rebekah's character, signaling the Lord's provision of a suitable wife.
- Jacob took bold initiative rather than waiting, rolling the heavy stone away to water his uncle's sheep.
- Believers must trust through faith that God actively governs life's unexpected circumstances to accomplish His good purposes.
